data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-sh-r' meaning 'to be heavy or strong'. In Islamic tradition, Khashar is a name for the brave and fearless. The name Khashar carries the meaning “Bold, Fearless” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khashar usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
